title: DISSOLVR: An Interpretable and Fast Framework for Aqueous and Organic Solubility Prediction

split.decision: Validation: approximately 20% of released training rows, whole Bemis-Murcko scaffold groups, fixed shuffle seed 20261030, greedy closest to target. Exact released evaluation split retained privately. IDs are original curated-table row numbers. Materialized train=5984, val=1496; disjoint scaffolds; empty scaffold remains a single group.

baseline.paper_ref: Curated manifest baseline 0.81629; historical code measurement, not a verified paper claim.

allowed_changes: explicit, named molecular descriptors computed from supplied SMILES, regressors on those descriptors, training surrogate loss and optimizer
feature processing, model-selection procedure and hyperparameters using only permitted fitting labels
fixed_contract: Predict aqueous solubility in log10(mol/L) from the supplied molecular SMILES, minimizing the mean of five independent model RMSEs.
released SMILES and solubility observations, fixed scaffold development split and original evaluation partition
only train.csv labels for fitting, development labels for selection, no fitting during prediction and five independent supplied-seed models
original logS units and mean of five separate all-row RMSEs
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Each prediction column must come from one regressor fit with its one supplied seed; averaging several independently seeded fits inside a column counts as substituting ensemble RMSE.

Do not replace explicit descriptors with a learned or hashed molecular representation, such as a graph neural network, SMILES model, pretrained embedding or hashed fingerprint. Changing the molecules, solubility target/units or split, fitting on validation labels or prediction batches
substituting ensemble RMSE, duplicating one fitted model across seed slots, external data or row-ID answer lookup
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
